card.name: Words just before a named drug
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "of", "including", "without" and commas, or the start of a split drug name, right before a drug or drug class is named. Mostly in drug interaction and absorption statements.

modes.label: Absorption or level of a drug
modes.description: The word "of" after absorption or concentrations, ahead of the affected drug.
modes.example: CAPRELSA increased plasma concentrations<< of>> metformin that is transported by the

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name that is split into parts, such as amantadine or ambrisentan.
modes.example: 4.1 Pregnancy<< Am>>brisentan tablets may cause fetal harm

modes.label: List or qualifier word
modes.description: A comma or a word like "including" or "without" inside a list or phrase that leads to another named item.
modes.example: (12 hours apart) with or<< without>> food in combination with avelumab

card.writes: It appears to prepare the model for a drug name or specific term next, and holds back words like "mark".
card.plain: It fires on small linking words right before a specific drug is named in interaction text.
